name: no-js-ts-profile-for-prose
description: Mentioning JavaScript test tools in prose must not activate js_ts or trigger tool installation. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor and stage README.md as an addition against an empty Git baseline.
prompt: Validate this README-only change using the applicable checks. Keep the files unchanged; report which checks apply.
trap: The agent matches Node, TypeScript, or Vitest keywords in a README rather than source-extension signals, loads JS/TS test guidance, and runs or installs a test runner for a prose-only fixture.

assertions.text: Agent runs profile detection against the staged README.md and reports no active profiles; the tool names in its prose do not activate js_ts, and no SKILL.md ancestor activates skill-md in the staged workspace.
Agent skips profile-specific test content, including js_ts/test/, and falls back to generic applicable verification without skipping detection itself.
Agent neither runs nor installs Node/TypeScript/Vitest solely because they are mentioned, makes no file changes, and reports documentation-only verification without claiming application tests passed.
